name: button-group
title: Button group
description: Groups related buttons into one control, or joins a main action with its options as a split button.

when: Two to four related actions belong together.
A main action has a menu of variants (split).

ButtonGroup.name: inputMode
ButtonGroup.description: Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its contents

ButtonGroup.name: is
ButtonGroup.description: Specify that a standard HTML element should behave like a defined custom built-in element

ButtonGroup.name: aria-activedescendant
ButtonGroup.description: Identifies the currently active element when DOM focus is on a composite widget, textbox, group, or application.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-atomic
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates whether assistive technologies will present all, or only parts of, the changed region based on the change notifications defined by the aria-relevant attribute.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-autocomplete
ButtonGroup.description:
Indicates whether inputting text could trigger display of one or more predictions of the user's intended value for an input and specifies how predictions would be
presented if they are made.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-braillelabel
ButtonGroup.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element, which is intended to be converted into Braille.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-brailleroledescription
ButtonGroup.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized abbreviated description for the role of an element, which is intended to be converted into Braille.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-checked
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates the current "checked" state of checkboxes, radio buttons, and other widgets.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-colcount
ButtonGroup.description: Defines the total number of columns in a table, grid, or treegrid.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-colindex
ButtonGroup.description: Defines an element's column index or position with respect to the total number of columns within a table, grid, or treegrid.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-colindextext
ButtonGroup.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-colindex.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-colspan
ButtonGroup.description: Defines the number of columns spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-controls
ButtonGroup.description: Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current element.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-current
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related elements.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-describedby
ButtonGroup.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-description
ButtonGroup.description: Defines a string value that describes or annotates the current element.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-details
ButtonGroup.description: Identifies the element that provides a detailed, extended description for the object.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-disabled
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise operable.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-dropeffect
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates what functions can be performed when a dragged object is released on the drop target.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-errormessage
ButtonGroup.description: Identifies the element that provides an error message for the object.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-expanded
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded or collapsed.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-flowto
ButtonGroup.description:
Identifies the next element (or elements) in an alternate reading order of content which, at the user's discretion,
allows assistive technology to override the general default of reading in document source order.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-grabbed
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates an element's "grabbed" state in a drag-and-drop operation.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-haspopup
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that can be triggered by an element.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-hidden
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-invalid
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates the entered value does not conform to the format expected by the application.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-keyshortcuts
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates keyboard shortcuts that an author has implemented to activate or give focus to an element.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-label
ButtonGroup.description:
Defines a string value that labels the current element.
Names the group for screen readers ("View", "Export").

ButtonGroup.name: aria-labelledby
ButtonGroup.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-level
ButtonGroup.description: Defines the hierarchical level of an element within a structure.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-live
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-modal
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates whether an element is modal when displayed.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-multiline
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates whether a text box accepts multiple lines of input or only a single line.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-multiselectable
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates that the user may select more than one item from the current selectable descendants.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-orientation
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates whether the element's orientation is horizontal, vertical, or unknown/ambiguous.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-owns
ButtonGroup.description:
Identifies an element (or elements) in order to define a visual, functional, or contextual parent/child relationship
between DOM elements where the DOM hierarchy cannot be used to represent the relationship.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-placeholder
ButtonGroup.description:
Defines a short hint (a word or short phrase) intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value.
A hint could be a sample value or a brief description of the expected format.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-posinset
ButtonGroup.description: Defines an element's number or position in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-pressed
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-readonly
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates that the element is not editable, but is otherwise operable.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-relevant
ButtonGroup.type: "additions" | "additions removals" | "additions text" | "all" | "removals" | "removals additions" | "removals text" | "text" | "text additions" | "text removals" | undefined
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates what notifications the user agent will trigger when the accessibility tree within a live region is modified.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-required
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates that user input is required on the element before a form may be submitted.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-roledescription
ButtonGroup.description: Defines a human-readable, author-localized description for the role of an element.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-rowcount
ButtonGroup.description: Defines the total number of rows in a table, grid, or treegrid.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-rowindex
ButtonGroup.description: Defines an element's row index or position with respect to the total number of rows within a table, grid, or treegrid.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-rowindextext
ButtonGroup.description: Defines a human readable text alternative of aria-rowindex.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-rowspan
ButtonGroup.description: Defines the number of rows spanned by a cell or gridcell within a table, grid, or treegrid.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-selected
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates the current "selected" state of various widgets.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-setsize
ButtonGroup.description: Defines the number of items in the current set of listitems or treeitems. Not required if all elements in the set are present in the DOM.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-sort
ButtonGroup.description: Indicates if items in a table or grid are sorted in ascending or descending order.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-valuemax
ButtonGroup.description: Defines the maximum allowed value for a range widget.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-valuemin
ButtonGroup.description: Defines the minimum allowed value for a range widget.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-valuenow
ButtonGroup.description: Defines the current value for a range widget.

ButtonGroup.name: aria-valuetext
ButtonGroup.description: Defines the human readable text alternative of aria-valuenow for a range widget.

ButtonGroup.name: variant
ButtonGroup.description:
`split`: a primary main action with an icon button that opens a menu of
alternatives; the seam uses the pressed brand fill instead of `ds-border`.
